name: quasar
description: Quasar cluster resources and limits as the native binary_ng factory and the DFB host see them.

dm_cores.source: binary_ng_utils.hpp kNativeUserDmCores=6; DM0 = DFB ISR, DM1 = remapper (RES:36-40)

limits.source: binary_ng_utils.cpp native_tuning TT_FATALs; factory num_entries<=255 (uint8 threshold); RES:83-140

l1.source: worker_l1_size 4194304 (RES:56-59). reserved_bytes is an ASSUMPTION for firmware, kernel code and allocator reservations; confirm from the allocator before trusting a near-limit L1 verdict.
l1.bank_mapping: unknown: address hashing per NEO HLS; the model does not assume bank = address % banks

noc.source: NOC_PAYLOAD_WIDTH 2048 bits; cluster NoC 4R+4W L1 ports

aiclk_GHz.source: HAS Table 9 preliminary NoC clocks 0.76/1.33/1.55 GHz; Tensix ~1.4 GHz (RES:1601, STA:871)

clocks.note: Simulator cost profiles are in simulator cycles; they declare their own clock. Cycles of different domains are never added.
